description: One JSON file that holds every path, model name, and tuning number, so changing a model or path never means editing code.

steps.description: The file sets `ollama_url` to the local Ollama server, `embed_model` to `nomic-embed-text`, and `chat_model` to `llama3.2`. The page says all settings live in `config.json` for exactly this reason.
Three location keys: `chroma_path` points at the on-disk vector store, `collection` names the Chroma collection, and `corpus_dir` points at the markdown documents.
Three tuning numbers: `chunk_chars` sets the chunk size, `top_k` sets how many passages retrieval returns, and `max_distance` sets the distance cutoff for keeping a hit.
`log_level` sets the logging level, here `INFO`, and closes the JSON object.
